exposure: Farsi version of the Childbirth Experience Questionnaire 2.0 (CEQ 2.0)
outcome: Construct validity (exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis)
cohort: A total of 500 primiparous women, 4 to 16 weeks postpartum, were randomly selected from 54 healthcare centres in Tabriz, Iran.
finding: The Farsi version of the Childbirth Experience Questionnaire 2.0 tool was found to be a valid and reliable instrument for measuring childbirth experience in Iranian women.
